title: What to do when my AI 3D Asset looks like this:
author: Ecstatic-Stage-2477
selftext:
Hey guys,   
Brand new (few months here) ai game developer learning about godot, blender, and all the ai tools (mostly codex, meshy) to hit the gas in making a game assets. 

I’m trying to out a familiar neighborhood in a game and am trying to have meshy build out a few buildings and properties. I really like the looks of what meshy has done. In some ways I think even this is workable (textures are right, the general shape, etc). 

Does anyone have any tips or tools for turning that 👆monstrosity into a decent looking house?

comments.author: meathelix1
comments.body: You really dont need Meshy for a house design. Its not built for that, no 3d generator is built for that. I suggest using Opus or GPT with a Blender MCP with a detailed prompt.

replies.author: Maximum-Substance-62
replies.body:
I got a pretty good building design from meshy. This is after decimating it from 2M tris down to a couple hundred thousand and just baking the original texture onto the lower ploy mesh

https://preview.redd.it/st9j5yluorrh1.png?width=1379&format=png&auto=webp&s=436df5e49c9b0ed538627fb93463fc1c55121a41

replies.author: meathelix1
replies.body: yeah go up close too it. You forget that builds are straight up simple shapes... can be manually done quite fast.

comments.author: Aggressive_Tie_3014
comments.body: That model is completely unusable in every possible way it could be. Any work you'd need to do to 'fix' that would be magnitudes more difficult than simply making it with your own bare hands out of geometric shapes in Blockbench or Blender.

replies.author: Ecstatic-Stage-2477
replies.body: What if I have the player take acid?

comments.author: Ok_Improvement_8735
comments.body: I'm pretty sure on the openai website there's a demo for making a house. It uses the type of house plan where you can see that top down room by room design blueprint, there's some software for those design layouts too I forget what it's called. There were also some reddit posts where a user had those room by room blueprints and some example pictures of exterior design elements and the ai did it very well.

comments.author: ds1841
comments.body: If you've got opus or astra, ask them to make a parametric house similar to that (or give it a better ref) in three.js. then feed that into your game agent. Do not ask your game agent to make, even if it's also opus or astra. Use a different one

replies.author: Ecstatic-Stage-2477
replies.body: I hadn’t thought of that.. using three.js as a step between an image and 3d model. Has that technique worked for you?

comments.author: No-Trouble-9138
comments.body: Prompt it to make modular assets, so you can have many combinations.
